name: Massive DML offline bulk load with maintained indexes
description: Repeated disposable bulk-load experiment with secondary indexes maintained while rows are inserted.

measurement.scope: PostgreSQL server clock around table creation, required secondary-index creation, and row insertion; ANALYZE is excluded.

assurance: A passing series proves exact repeated runs, linked-run integrity, result parsing, and aggregate reproducibility for this disposable environment. It does not prove production capacity, universal superiority, TPC compliance, or causal equivalence with a separately scheduled series.
